tasks_tab_rows: Nov 19–20 Lesson and Task: Areas Under the Normal Curve (z-table)

2-day lesson (Nov 19 and 20) on finding areas under the normal curve with the z-table, plus a short task (about 20 minutes). Open the PDF, read Day 1 and Day 2, then do the task on paper and upload a clear photo of your work here. The z-table is inside the PDF. All numbers are made up for practice. Work indoors and rest if it is too hot. No deadline. After this, take the 10-item quiz.
Nov 19–20 Lesson and Task: Data and Ways to Collect Data

2-day lesson (Nov 19 and 20) on data, and on interview, observation, and document review, plus a short task (about 20 minutes). Open the PDF, read both days, then answer the task in your notebook and upload a clear photo of your work here. This is practice only: do not interview anyone or collect real data. Work indoors and rest if it is too hot. No deadline. After this, take the 10-item quiz.
Nov 19–20 Lesson and Task: Weighted Mean of a Likert Item (Chapter IV)

2-day lesson (Nov 19 and 20) on computing the weighted mean of a Likert item and the overall weighted mean, plus a short task (about 20 minutes). Open the PDF, read both days, then do the task on paper and upload a clear photo of your work here. All data are sample data made up for practice. Work indoors and rest if it is too hot. No deadline. After this, take the 10-item quiz.
Nov 19–20 Lesson and Task: Empowerment and Advocacy

2-day lesson (Nov 19 and 20) on empowerment and advocacy in community action, plus a short task (about 20 minutes). Open the PDF, read both days, then answer the task on paper and upload a clear photo of your work here. The case is imaginary: no fieldwork, no outdoor activity, and do not post anyone's name or photo. Work indoors and rest if it is too hot. No deadline. After this, take the 10-item quiz.
Nov 19–20 Lesson and Task: Pricing My Product (Unit Cost and Markup)

2-day lesson (Nov 19 and 20) on unit cost and cost-plus pricing, plus a short task (about 25 minutes). Open the PDF, read both days, then do Part A and fill in your own Price Card (Part B) on paper. Upload a clear photo of your work here. Use estimates for your own product; you do not need to buy anything. Work indoors and rest if it is too hot. No deadline. After this, take the 10-item quiz.
